comparison.objective: Compress fifteen pool balls into a correctly oriented tight rack, then remove and set aside the triangle without disturbance.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object packing, contact-sensitive alignment, and clearance of a surrounding fixture.
comparison.success_condition: Head ball at the foot spot, prescribed neighboring pairs within 0.5 mm, correct pack orientation, rack removed, balls still, and no disturbance during lift-off.
comparison.reason: This tests dense multi-object arrangement and fixture removal. The candidate transports one container while retaining its contents rather than arranging or exposing the individual contents.
